simplemodels.browser.title: Simple Models
simplemodels.browser.tab_hint: Browse and assign server-approved item models
simplemodels.browser.search: Search name, item, author, or tag
simplemodels.browser.assign_hint: Select the model, then take the result from the anvil. Server rules and level costs apply.
simplemodels.browser.empty: No approved models match. Ask the server administrator to add definitions and reload the catalog.
simplemodels.browser.import: Add or remove JSON definitions in config/simplemodels/catalog on the server, then run /simplemodels reload. Put rendering assets in an enabled folder resource pack (assets/<namespace>/items, models, textures). Reload Assets refreshes previews. Multiplayer servers distribute assets with the standard server resource pack URL and SHA-1 settings; never share private files. Assignment requires an anvil and an empty second slot. Model changes do not change item names or stats. Server Settings is read-only; admins edit config/simplemodels/config.json. The catalog's JSON format is described in the Simple Models documentation of the project repository.
text.autoconfig.simplemodels.option.enab:
Allow cosmetic model changes at anvils.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simplemodels.option.oper:
Only operators with game master permission
may assign or remove models. Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simplemodels.option.allo:
Allow explicitly approved mod items; gameplay
components remain unchanged. Default: false.
text.autoconfig.simplemodels.option.lega:
Also accept exact match_name text at anvils.
No suffix matching or hidden identity.
Default: false.
text.autoconfig.simplemodels.option.leve:
Levels charged by the vanilla anvil per model
change, capped at 1–10. Default: 1.
text.autoconfig.simplemodels.option.maxM:
Approved definitions, capped at 1–64 and
24,000 serialized characters. Default: 64.
text.autoconfig.simplemodels.option.maxF:
JSON definition bytes, capped at 256–16384.
Invalid, nested, or oversized files are
rejected. Default: 16384.
text.autoconfig.simplemodels.option.buil:
Offer the six example models shipped with
Simple Models (stool, lantern, mailbox ...).
Default: true.

simplemodels.guide.page.1.title: Simple Models
simplemodels.guide.page.1: Server-approved custom item models, anvil assignment and a searchable model browser.
simplemodels.guide.page.2.title: Anvil Assignment
simplemodels.guide.page.2: Put an approved base item in the left anvil slot, leave the second slot empty, choose Models, then Assign and take the result. Only item_model changes; names, enchantments, counts, durability, and other components remain intact.
simplemodels.guide.page.3.title: Anvil Assignment
simplemodels.guide.page.3: Removal uses the same anvil costs and permissions.
simplemodels.guide.page.4.title: Model Browser
simplemodels.guide.page.4: The Models bookmark on the inventory, the creative inventory and the anvil opens the browser; while the recipe book is open it sits on the top edge. Search name, item id, model id, author, or tags;
simplemodels.guide.page.5.title: Model Browser
simplemodels.guide.page.5: filter by base item and sort by name (A–Z, Z–A) or base item. The mouse wheel turns the pages. Rows render actual item models; hovering one shows the base item and an enlarged model preview.
simplemodels.guide.page.6.title: Model Browser
simplemodels.guide.page.6: Server Settings shows on/off values as read-only switches. Inventory browsing never modifies items.
simplemodels.guide.page.7.title: Folder Catalog and Resource Packs
simplemodels.guide.page.7: Add or remove JSON definitions in config/simplemodels/catalog on the server, then run /simplemodels reload.
simplemodels.guide.page.8.title: Folder Catalog and Resource Packs
simplemodels.guide.page.8: Put rendering assets in an enabled folder resource pack (assets/<namespace>/items, models, textures). Reload Assets refreshes previews.
simplemodels.guide.page.9.title: Folder Catalog and Resource Packs
simplemodels.guide.page.9: Multiplayer servers distribute assets with the standard server resource pack URL and SHA-1 settings; never share private files. Assignment requires an anvil and an empty second slot.
simplemodels.guide.page.10.title: Folder Catalog and Resource Packs
simplemodels.guide.page.10: Model changes do not change item names or stats. Server Settings is read-only; admins edit config/simplemodels/config.json.
simplemodels.guide.page.11.title: Folder Catalog and Resource Packs
simplemodels.guide.page.11: The catalogue's JSON format is described in the Simple Models documentation of the project repository.
simplemodels.guide.page.12.title: Example Models
simplemodels.guide.page.12: Six example models come built in and need no resource pack:
simplemodels.guide.page.13.title: Example Models
simplemodels.guide.page.13: Stool (oak slab), Table Lantern (lantern), Mailbox (barrel), Birdhouse (oak fence), Weather Vane (lightning rod) and Crystal Cluster (amethyst cluster).
simplemodels.guide.page.14.title: Example Models
simplemodels.guide.page.14: Assign them at the anvil with @model:simplemodels:stool and so on. They only use vanilla block textures. A definition with the same id in config/simplemodels/catalog replaces the built-in one;
simplemodels.guide.page.15.title: Example Models
simplemodels.guide.page.15: the server option Built-in Examples turns them off.
simplemodels.guide.page.16.title: Model Editor (preview)
simplemodels.guide.page.16: The Editor button in the model browser opens the selected model (otherwise the stool example) in a Blockbench-like editor:
simplemodels.guide.page.17.title: Model Editor (preview)
simplemodels.guide.page.17: cube list with show/hide, a 3D view (right drag turns, Shift or middle button pans, wheel zooms,
simplemodels.guide.page.18.title: Model Editor (preview)
simplemodels.guide.page.18: number pad 1/3/7 front/right/top), and a gizmo to move (G), rotate (R) or scale (S, Ctrl both sides) the selected cube on
simplemodels.guide.page.19.title: Model Editor (preview)
simplemodels.guide.page.19: a 1 / 0.5 / 0.25 px grid (Alt: free; rotation 22.5°, Shift 1°). Number fields take exact values, Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y undo and redo, N adds a cube, Ctrl+D duplicates, Del deletes.
simplemodels.guide.page.20.title: Model Editor (preview)
simplemodels.guide.page.20: Code only (F4) shows the vanilla model JSON next to a live preview; invalid code keeps the last valid model. Saving and exporting follow in a later stage.
simplemodels.guide.page.21.title: Multiplayer Safety
simplemodels.guide.page.21: The server owns the catalog and policy.
simplemodels.guide.page.22.title: Multiplayer Safety
simplemodels.guide.page.22: It syncs definitions to clients; clients cannot upload models or select an arbitrary item_model. Default operator-only assignment. Disabling assignment refuses new changes;
simplemodels.guide.page.23.title: Multiplayer Safety
simplemodels.guide.page.23: existing saved cosmetic components remain. No hidden item identity, automatic downloads, arbitrary file paths, or gameplay stats.
simplemodels.guide.page.24.title: Legacy renamed Compatibility
simplemodels.guide.page.24: No item/block/entity/enchantment registries existed in renamed. Definition fields id, base_item, match_name, model, tags, author remain readable; bare ids use the renamed namespace.
simplemodels.guide.page.25.title: Legacy renamed Compatibility
simplemodels.guide.page.25: Optional exact legacy anvil name matching preserves custom names. The old unsafe bracket-hiding/render mixins are replaced by item_model. No new items, blocks, mobs, recipes, loot, advancements, or keybinds are added.
simplemodels.guide.page.26.title: Legacy renamed Compatibility
simplemodels.guide.page.26: Block-item appearances are supported; placed block geometry is not changed.
simplemodels.guide.page.27.title: /simplemodels reload
simplemodels.guide.page.27: Game master permission is required. Rescan the server folder and policy, then synchronize the new catalog to connected players. Add/remove files without restarting.
simplemodels.guide.page.28.title: /simplemodels reload
simplemodels.guide.page.28: Malformed policy disables assignment; bad definitions are skipped with server logs.
simplemodels.guide.page.29.title: Settings
simplemodels.guide.page.29: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
